evidence.explanation: The research summary reports nearly tripled Amazon e-book release rates between 2022 and late 2025, alongside lower average quality measured mainly through reader-rating counts. It also reports better outcomes at some absolute rank positions and modeled gains from expanded choice; those qualifications prevent interpreting the findings as evidence that every additional book lacks value.
